name: Die Waldruhe
beschreibung: The hotel Die Waldruhe is located in the village of Kartitsch in the Tiroler Gailtal. Its location is on the edge of the village and directly surrounded by forests, which provides a quiet atmosphere. The amenities include a sauna area and a restaurant garden with a view of the Karnischen Alpen. The house is family-run and places emphasis on regional cuisine with products from the surrounding area. Guests are mainly hikers and nature vacationers who appreciate the quiet location away from through traffic. The rooms are functionally furnished and designed for the needs of those seeking relaxation.
